summary: Heritage Financial Corporation filed an 8-K to announce its first quarter 2026 earnings results, release an investor presentation, and declare a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.24 per share. The dividend is payable on May 20, 2026, to shareholders of record on May 6, 2026. There is no special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring involved. The filing is a routine current report covering operational and financial condition updates.
